findings.value: A contemporary art gallery in the Bethnal Green area that mixes art and fashion, according to Plaster magazine (2024). Its own website lists shows running into December 2026.

evidence.quote: has been expertly combining art and fashion with playful shows

notes: Plaster magazine (January 2024) puts the gallery in the Bethnal Green area, but its wording is loose, so the summary keeps the area vague. The own-site dates are for 2026 shows, which suggests it is open, but no closure or opening news was found. Only one press source was found: WebSearch budget ran out, and artrabbit.com was refused under the never-use policy.  The homepage shows no date of its own, so the summary has no source_date.
